gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that IndexedCollection indexes pre-existing elements when wrapping an already-populated collection (i.e. the constructor calls reindex()).
ADDED i2: Converts a numeric string to its Integer value, used as the index key.
ADDED i3: Wraps a collection in a non-unique IndexedCollection keyed by integer value.
ADDED i4: Wraps a collection in a unique IndexedCollection keyed by integer value.
ADDED i5: Returns a full collection containing the elements {"1","3","5","7","2","4","6"}.
ADDED i6: When a pre-populated collection is wrapped by IndexedCollection, all existing elements must be present in the index so that get(key) works immediately.
